activity.notes: Tenenisk (also Tininisk/Tenenesk) was a documented Fuegian shaman of mixed Haush and Selk'nam background, associated with the Punta Azara clan. He is not securely attested as a political chief of the Haush. ATLAS therefore records only a representative c.1899 attestation point as a shaman active in the Haush community rather than fabricating a reign or treating the Haush as 'under' him.

sources.title: Uttermost Part of the Earth — E. Lucas Bridges
sources.citation_text: Bridges' ethnographic memoir is a primary biographical source for Tininisk/Tenenisk among the Fuegian peoples.

sources.title: Tenenisk — Haush shaman, historical photograph
sources.citation_text: The historical photograph is dated approximately 1899 and identifies Tenenisk as a well-known shaman of mixed Haush and Selk'nam background.
